mandatory_methodological_guards.sa_fhl1_truth_in_labeling: Every adjunct activity present in the tested lot (SA-FasL, SA-THBD, SA-FHL-1, carrier chemistry) must be declared via adjunct_sa_fhl1_status in {DEPLETED_VERIFIED, RETAINED_ACTIVE, ABSENT_FROM_LOT}; a FasL/THBD-depleted lot retaining active SA-FHL-1 is classified as PARTIAL_FASL_THBD_DEPLETED_SA_FHL1_RETAINED_ACTIVE_NOT_COMPLETE_ADJUNCT_DEPLETION and never as complete adjunct depletion.
mandatory_methodological_guards.depletion_mode_non_pooling: adjunct_depletion_mode distinguishes NATURAL_AGING_DECAY from PHYSICAL_WASHOUT; calibration ledger replay rejects pooling across the two modes unless separate comparability qualification is established.
mandatory_methodological_guards.immune_responder_compartment_and_mhc_pat: adjunct_immune_responder_history distinguishes RETAINED_CONDITIONED_RESPONDERS (testing persistence of local conditioning; FoxP3+ counts alone do not establish functional suppression), FRESH_RECIPIENT_RESPONDERS (testing graft resistance to renewed recipient HLA-DQ2/DQ8/DR4 APC + memory T-cell challenge), and PAIRED_BOTH, and separates MHC-II indirect CD4+ presentation from MHC-I CD8+ cross-presentation.
mandatory_methodological_guards.ectopic_cd55_scr14_unconfounded_causal_c: Ectopic CD55(SCR1-4) complement evaluation remains an experimental satellite alongside the existing Layer-3 CD47-CD55 / 2A-free CD55+CD59 challenger and Playbook 20% NHS <=5.0% lysis gate: its primary causal contrast is exact same edited graft background + ectopic CD55(SCR1-4) (with declared GPI vs TM membrane anchor, localization, QuantiBRITE density, and PIGK GPI-biosynthesis non-competition against CD47-IgV-GPI and endogenous CD59) vs exact same edited graft background without ectopic CD55 under matched delivery/mock handling and intact endogenous CD59; unedited WT (van der Torren 2017 PMID:27787618) and CD59 loss-of-function (which also perturbs IRIS-1/2 insulin exocytosis per Golec 2022 PMID:35666870) are supplementary references only.

held_challenger_families.falsifier_scope: Evaluates TYMS disruption strictly as an additive dividing-cell containment challenger alongside retained, functionally verified biallelic pan-lineage AAVS1 iCasp9 (never a whole-graft post-mitotic erasability substitute; GY-002). Reconciles live Ensembl ENST00000323274.15 vs .9 (Exon 1 chr18:657653-657947, CDS start chr18:657743, antisense ENOSF1 ENSG00000132199 start chr18:667671; noting chr18:657600-658000 spans noncoding sequence rather than defining an exact allele, Tummala 2022 PMID:35931051 established ENOSF1-to-TYMS suppression rather than exon-5 KO damage to ENOSF1, and nuclease TYMS KO adds a K chromosomal cut rather than a B base edit under GY-006). Tests proliferation arrest across supplemented 2'-deoxythymidine (dThd, 0.1-20 uM) as an aggressive salvage-vulnerability falsifier (Sartori-Maldonado 2024 PMID:38867450 rescued KO proliferation at 20 uM dThd and noted dying-cell salvage and 3D residual growth), requires dTTP/dUTP nucleotide-balance, >=63,000x duplex-seq/CAST-seq genomic integrity, vascular/stromal (iEC/iPericyte) bank compatibility, intact Stage-7 perifusion GSIS, and intact AP1903 >=4-log10 kill.

Requires isoform-specific RT-ddPCR/long-read junction assays distinguishing endogenous CD274 Exon3-included vs Exon2->Exon4 skipped transcripts and endogenous surface vs secreted protein from the intronless Locus-3 PD-L1 cDNA cassette, cis PDCD1LG2 (PD-L2) undisturbed expression, and functional PD-1 engagement (GY-001, GY-006, GY-008).

Requires matched cluster-size controls across 48-h 1% O2 hypoxia plus reoxygenation recovery, measuring absolute viable INS+NKX6-1+ beta-cell recovery per starting input, alpha/delta survival, basal insulin secretion, dynamic GSIS, low-glucose shut-off (t50 and t90), and cellular OCR without waiving G6PC2/RNLS or Layer-4 oxygen-budget gates (GY-003, GY-004).
